blocks.h2: When Gas Piping Needs a Plumber

tiles.h3: You Smell Gas Near an Appliance
tiles.body: Range, water heater, dryer or fireplace.
Repairs and a pressure test come first.

bodies: We locate gas leaks with electronic detectors and by testing fittings, then pressure-test the system to confirm it's sealed.

In older Lincoln Park buildings, we often find leaks at old unions, at original valves and on branches left from appliances removed decades ago. After the repair, the system is tested again so Peoples Gas can restore service.

blocks.h2: Gas Leaks in Buildings With Many Meters
blocks.body: A Lincoln Park building may have a row of gas meters in the basement, one for each unit, plus one for shared equipment. When Peoples Gas shuts off service, tracing which piping belongs to which meter is the first job. We find the leak on the affected system, repair it and pressure-test it, so service can be restored to the right units without disturbing the others.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave and call Peoples Gas or 911.
items.answer: Leave the building without touching switches. Call Peoples Gas or 911 from outside, then call us.

items.q: Who owns the gas piping in my building?
items.preview: The utility up to the meter, the owner after.
items.answer: Peoples Gas handles the line up to and including the meter. Piping after the meter belongs to the owner or the condo association.

items.q: Can you cap old gas lines?
items.answer: Yes. We cap abandoned branches properly and test the system.

items.q: How long until gas service is restored?
items.preview: After the repair and pressure test.
items.answer: Once we repair and test the line, Peoples Gas can restore service.

items.q: Will the whole building lose gas?
items.answer: Usually only the meter with the leak, unless the problem is before the meters.

items.q: How much does gas line repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how much pipe needs work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
